title: University of Maryland, College Park — McKeldin Mall outdoor study
authorship: Original procedural geometry; reference images are inspected only and are not shipped as textures or copied meshes.
scope: A playable stylized approximation of the McKeldin Mall core. Not a surveyed architectural reconstruction and not the complete College Park campus. Interiors, active water physics, event schedules and access control are not represented.

coordinateFrame.origin: authored centre of the McKeldin Mall campus composition
coordinateFrame.simplifications: The roughly east–west campus axis is aligned with local x. Ground slopes are flattened; library and administration terraces retain low steps. Side-building spacing, facade dimensions, roof heights and tree positions are approximate, composed from the official campus plan and photos. They are not geodetic coordinates.

landmarks.name: McKeldin Library

landmarks.name: Thomas V. Miller Jr. Administration Building
McKeldin Mall and Omicron Delta Kappa Fountain
features: five leadership tiers expressed as shallow basins
long lawns and parallel pedestrian paths

secondaryContext.status: Simplified red-brick context masses with recessed window and door details; exterior dimensions and exact architectural ornament are illustrative.

playability.fountain: Solid shallow-basin collision proxy prevents walking into the water
playability.vegetation: Six broad lawn footprints plus two narrow fountain-side turf strips exclude the primary paving and fountain. Actual-ground-height masking removes blade roots where the raised cross-paths overlap the narrow strips; the common tree system receives trunk locations and canopy radii
